period_note: COVID-19-affected year. Cumulative-from-Jan-1 convention established from the filing's own column header '01 January to 30 September 2020' (the filing also separately shows a discrete '01 July to 30 September' 3-month column: Net Profit after tax BDT 554.37mn, EPS 0.59, included here for reference only, not as a structured line item). Standalone/Solo basis. SOURCING NOTE: the live nccbank.com.bd URL for this file (3rd_quarter_2020.pdf) now 404s; the only available source is a Wayback Machine capture (20221203095558) which Internet Archive's own metadata confirms was itself truncated at exactly 1,048,576 bytes versus an original crawled size of 1,304,704 bytes ('warning: 299 wayback content truncated by length') -- this is a permanent gap in Internet Archive's stored copy, not a retrieval error, and no alternate capture exists in the CDX index. However, the truncation only affects later note/schedule pages (roughly pages 26-33 of 33); the standalone Balance Sheet (page 5) and Profit and Loss Account (pages 7-8), which are what this record uses, are both fully intact and were independently verified: balance sheet ties to the taka (Total Liabilities 236,146,746,135 + Total Equity 20,017,531,400 = Total Assets 256,164,277,535); Profit before tax 3,069,532,571 - Provision for tax 1,402,378,988 = Profit after tax 1,667,153,583, matching the filing's own EPS of 1.76. Cross-check: comparative '31 December 2019' column (Total Assets BDT 256,887.04mn, Total Deposits BDT 200,018.31mn, Total Equity BDT 19,367.41mn) matches the existing bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2019_Q4.json exactly -- no discrepancy.

source.source_page_lines: Wayback-captured source PDF: standalone Balance Sheet 'As on 30 September 2020' (page 5) and standalone Profit and Loss Account 'For the period ended on 30 September 2020' (pages 7-8). pdftotext -layout via poppler's object-scan recovery mode (the capture's own xref table is broken by the truncation) successfully recovered these earlier pages intact; only later notes/schedules (~pages 26-33) are missing.
